summary: The lines move: {organizer} shows you the new district map: a seat that now fits where your support lives.
realLife: One life: She lost Texas House races in 1962 and 1964; after a court ordered new districts, a new Houston district elected her to the state senate in 1966. Another: He lost two citywide supervisor races; after voters approved district elections in 1976, he won his neighborhood's seat in 1977.
weights: How much of your old support falls inside the new lines.
How many times you have run.
choices: wait to see who else files

branches.then: Your first doors are on streets where you know people.
They call to ask whether you will step aside so they can move in.
You arrive in a body that has never had anyone like you.
